info.name: Google Neumorphic Redesign
info.description:
A complete redesign of the Google Search page featuring a Soft UI (Neumorphism) aesthetic. 

PLS NOTE: Light and dark modes are applied automatically based on your browser's light/dark mode settings. 
For example in Chrome, go to chrome://settings/appearance and under "Mode", you have Light, Dark, and Device (auto). Set it to whichever and the style will also match it.
info.additionalInfo:
PLS NOTE: Light and dark modes are applied automatically based on your browser's light/dark mode settings. 

For example in Chrome, go to chrome://settings/appearance and under "Mode", you have Light, Dark, and Device (auto). Set it to whichever and the style will also match it.

Support for other parts of Google search coming in the future.
